# Create Photo Album

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Create's a new photo album with the given photos and names.

## Syntax

~~~~text
createAlbum(photos: <#Variable (Optional)#>, name: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
createAlbum(photos: Ask, name: "New Album")
~~~~
